subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Gifting Circles and Cash Boards
description: A quick win: understand Gifting Circles and Cash Boards.

hook.text: Give $5,000 as a 'gift' to a stranger. When you reach the center of the circle, you get $40,000.

buildup.text: Gifting circles rename pyramid mechanics as 'empowerment' or 'women helping women.'

discovery.text: The math is identical to a pyramid. Eight people must join for one person to cash out.

twist.text: They target tight-knit communities — churches, mothers' groups — where saying no feels disloyal.

climax.text: When the circle runs out of recruits, the last joiners lose everything and friendships shatter.

punchline.text: Calling fraud a gift doesn't make it generous.

quiz.question: Why do gifting circles target tight-knit communities?
options: Social pressure makes saying no feel disloyal
Laws don't apply to private groups
